verdict.rationale: The public business page lists several downloadable PDF forms, including the mass change registered agent form, the prepaid account application, and the apostilles request form, so some forms are downloadable from the site. However, the core formation documents (LLC, corporation, partnership) appear only as filing entries on FileDoc.do, not as downloadable forms. Instructions are shown only as a tutorial link. Missing for 10: downloadable formation/entity forms, downloadable instructions accompanying forms, explicit confirmation that no account is required, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
